lineage_notes.subject: The Inevitability Curve
lineage_notes.source_note: Chris Blask recalls coining the term around 1991–1992 while arguing that everyone on Earth would eventually get on the Internet. If that future was inevitable, a line already connected the present to it and future observers would be able to look back and see its exact shape. The immediate engineering argument was to go ahead and build a firewall. Chris recalls using the concept continuously thereafter.
